question: Quartet of Gurindervir, Animesh, Manikanta, Amlan rewrites men’s 4x100m national record. What was the new national record timing set in the men’s 4x100m relay?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**38.69 seconds**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• National Open Relays: Quartet of Gurindervir, Animesh, Manikanta, Amlan rewrites men’s 4x100m national record.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A **new national record** was set in the **men’s 4x100m relay** at the **2nd Indian Open Relay Competition**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held in **Chandigarh**.

 
 
• 
 
The team included **Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidhar, and Amlan Borgohain**.

 
 
• 
 
The team clocked **38.69 seconds**, breaking the previous record.

 
 
• 
 
The **previous national record** was **38.89 seconds**, set during the **2010 Commonwealth Games** in **Delhi**.
